candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check for _tos.length > 0 so that empty arrays are allowed and the function still returns true.
Delete the loop body so no external calls are made and the function still returns true.

Remove the effectless _d assignment statement to see if it changes the return value; actually it never does, so skipping this as per instructions. Let’s replace with something that really changes return. Replace `_d;` with `return false;` inside the loop so that when call succeeds, function returns false early.
Remove the for loop entirely so the function returns true without performing any transfers, regardless of _tos length.
